title: Principal Solutions Architect (Cloud, Infrastructure & Data)
description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

Solvd Cloud, Infra, Data & Security is growing fast, and our architecture leadership needs to keep up. We need someone who can take an unclear problem, define it, design the answer, and make sure it ships. You'll set technical direction across cloud, infrastructure, and data. You'll shape engagements and roadmaps before they're committed. And you'll stay close enough to delivery that what we design is what gets built. We operate AI-first: you'll use AI as a daily tool to move faster and multiply what you and the teams around you can deliver.

There will be ambiguity. That's the job. The plans don't exist yet, and you'll help write them.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW:

- You'll help define the business, not inherit it. The Cloud BU is rapidly scaling. The patterns, standards, and team habits you set now become how we operate.

- The scope is broad on purpose. It covers cloud foundations, Kubernetes platforms, data, and AI workloads, so you won't be boxed into one layer.

- Decisions move quickly. You'll work directly with BU leadership, and decisions take days, not quarters.

- The problems are current. The work is getting AI workloads into production safely, building data platforms that are governed, and keeping cloud spend under control.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

- Architecture direction. You'll define reference architectures, landing zones, and standards across AWS and Azure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code. You'll decide what we standardize and what we leave flexible.

- Data and AI platforms. You'll design lakehouse and warehouse, streaming, and governance patterns. You'll also design the platform layer that moves GenAI and agentic workloads from prototype to production, covering access control, evaluation, observability, and cost guardrails.

- Solution shaping. You'll lead technical discovery, size and de-risk the work, and write the solution designs and technical scope that teams commit to.

- AI-accelerated delivery. You'll use AI tools across the architecture lifecycle: discovery synthesis, design drafts, IaC and code generation, review, documentation, and estimation. You'll turn what works into repeatable patterns and prompts the team adopts. You'll also set the guardrails for how AI is used with client and production data.

- Security and compliance by design. You'll own IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and logging. Your designs need to hold up to SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regulated-industry scrutiny without slowing delivery down.

- Cost and operability. Every design ships with a run cost, reliability targets, an observability plan, and a rollback path.

- Raising the bar. You'll run design reviews, mentor architects and senior engineers, and turn repeat solutions into reusable accelerators.

WHAT YOU BRING:

Have 12+ years in infrastructure, cloud, or data engineering, including several years as the accountable architect for production systems at scale.

Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, production Kubernetes, and Terraform (or an equivalent IaC tool). You can still review a pull request credibly.

- Have designed and shipped modern data platforms, such as [Databricks / Snowflake / Fabric / Redshift], including governance and data quality, not just pipelin

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof operates identity infrastructure for high-consequence transactions. Built on a WebTrust-audited certificate authority and PKI-anchored verifiable credentials, Proof helps more than 8,000 businesses, from financial institutions and mortgage lenders to insurers and wealth managers, verify who is on the other side of a transaction. Having created the online notarization category, we're now extending into portable digital identity with our Verifiable Digital Credential (VDC) for banks, and into authorization for AI agents.
As Director of Product Marketing, you'll turn that technical foundation into positioning that a bank's Chief Risk Officer, head of digital, and compliance team all understand and act on. Day to day, you'll work across Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape messaging, lead launches, equip Sales to win, and make sure the market sees Proof as the trusted identity layer. You'll also lead and develop the product marketing function, starting with the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager.

Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

The Architecture team at Tenstorrent is designing the central compute chiplet that powers our next generation automotive SoC. This role is about turning real world automotive and safety requirements into architecture that performs, scales, and ships fast and reliably. If you think silicon design should start with clarity and end with confidence, this is where your experience makes the biggest impact.

Who You Are

• Approach design with a systems mindset, always thinking in trade offs, not just specs and block diagrams.

• Bring deep knowledge of SoC architecture, from interconnects and I/O to memory and CPUs.

• Confident working within performance, power, and reliability constraints.

• Familiar with, or eager to dive into, functional safety, ISO 2626

title: Account Executive
description:
Account Executive

About Us
Join our dynamic and results-driven sales team! Founded in 2022, Grandir Solutions is a high-growth digital marketing agency start-up dedicated to driving growth and delivering exceptional results for our clients nationwide. We specialize in tailored digital marketing strategies: SEO, AIO, PPC, SEM, content marketing, and social media campaigns. We’re a high-performing group of professionals who believe in combining hard work with a collaborative, engaging workplace culture. Our team thrives on innovation, mutual support, and celebrating wins together. If you’re an ambitious self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced environment where initiative is rewarded and professional growth is prioritized, you’ll fit right in. We believe sales is a craft, and we train and develop our team to help them master it.

This role manages and handles the end of the Grandir sales cycle, from discovery, demo, to contract negotiation. Benefits

• 24/7 gym & sauna access for in-office employees

locationText: Chicago, IL; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

Robinhood is seeking a Senior Manager, Valuation to lead and execute valuation analyses for private company investments, minority equity stakes, and other illiquid financial instruments held across the organization. This role will partner closely with Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR), Corporate Development, and the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee to ensure valuations are well-supported, defensible, and compliant with US GAAP (ASC 820, ASC 321/323) and SEC reporting requirements. This role reports into Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR) leadership and works closely with the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

Financial Modeling & Valuation Analysis

• Build and maintain complex financial models (DCF, comparable company/precedent transaction analyses, OPM/PWERM, Monte Carlo simulations) to support fair value measurements of private company investments and other illiquid holdings.

• Perform quarterly and event-driven valuations for private equity/venture-style investments, including waterfall/allocation analyses across complex capital structures (preferred stock, SAFEs, convertible notes, warrants).

• Develop and refine valuation methodologies in line with AICPA Private Equity and Venture Capital Valuation Guidelines.

Governance & Reporting

• Prepare valuation memos and supporting documentation for presentation to the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee and Audit Committee.

• Partner with TAFR to ensure valuation conclusions are properly reflected in consolidated financial statements and SEC disclosures (10-Q/10-K, 8-K as applicable).

• Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors (EY) on valuation-related audit requests, walkthroughs, and testing.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Collaborate with Corporate Development, Legal, and Investor Relations on new investment structuring, follow-on financings, and exit/liquidity events to assess valuation impacts.

• Advise on the accounting and valuation implications of new or complex investment structures (e.g., tiered/contingent consideration, equity-linked instruments).

Process & Controls

• Maintain and enhance internal controls (SOX) over the valuation process, including documentation standards, model governance, and data source validation.

• Drive continuous improvement of valuation templates, market data inputs, and benchmarking practices.

What you bring

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

• 10+ years of relevant experience in valuation, financial modeling, investment banking, or private equity/venture capital, with a focus on private company or illiquid investment valuation.

• Demonstrated expertise in building and auditing complex financial models (DCF, comparable company analysis, option pricing models, waterfall/allocation models).

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP fair value measurement guidance (ASC 820) and its application to private investments.

• Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting valuation conclusions to committees, auditors, or senior stakeholders.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel/financial modeling; familiarity with valuation software or platforms a plus.

October 29, 2024
About SHE-CAN
SHE-CAN (an acronym for Supporting Her Education Changes A Nation) is a global non-profit organization located in San Francisco, California USA, that builds female global leadership in post-conflict countries - Rwanda, Cambodia, Liberia and Guatemala. We help passionate young leaders win scholarships to U.S. colleges and universities, provide leadership training, and pair them with U.S. mentor teams who help them thrive in college and launch change-agent careers at home. To date, we have helped 119 young women from Rwanda, Cambodia, Liberia, and Guatemala win $37M+ in full scholarships at top U.S. colleges.

We are seeking a Country Coordinator for our Liberia program. We are interested in either an organization or an individual. The SHE-CAN Liberian Coordinator role is a part-time position that requires approximately 10 hours a month. In September 2023, the National Science Foundation selected The Engine to stand up The Builder Platform (TBP) to be a model for post-award support, catalyze commercialization of groundbreaking scientific and technological advancements, and spur regional economic development across two cohorts of NSF Regional Innovation Engine (NSF Engine) awardees. Bringing together the brightest minds in Tough Tech, The Builder Platform connects regional ecosystem builders to the capital, partners, tools and support they need to scale.
Our tailored support is fueling the growth of ecosystems supported by the NSF Regional Innovation Engines program - a flagship initiative that is driving regional innovation across the country.
The Builder Platform amplifies NSF's investments in regional innovation ecosystems, providing:
Peer learning environments,
Private sector network connections,
Full lifecycle support from early R&D to full-scale technology deployment in critical technology sectors.
The Builder Platform helps teams navigate microvalleys, reducing friction between stages, and accelerating the translation of breakthrough technologies.

You keep the books clean, the filings on time, and the numbers trustworthy, so the founders and leadership can make decisions on financials they can rely on.

title: SAP Solution Architect (w/m/d) - Schwerpunkt BTP
description:
worum gehts?

Cloud und moderne SAP-Technologien sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden auf das nächste Level heben? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! Wir suchen dich, um bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Cloud-Architekturen eine entscheidende Rolle einzunehmen.
Als Solution Architect SAP Business Technology Platform (w/m/d) hast du die spannende Aufgabe und den Gestaltungsspielraum, moderne BTP-Landschaften zu konzipieren, komplexe Systemwelten zu vernetzen und Kunden bei ihren Migrations- und Innovationsprojekten strategisch zu begleiten. Du verbindest fundiertes SAP-Know-how mit moderner Cloud-Entwicklung und steuerst anspruchsvolle Architekturen sicher in die Zukunft.

das wirst du tun

•
Beratung & Konzeption: Analyse bestehender Systemlandschaften und Definition von BTP-Architekturen sowie die Ableitung von technischen und funktionalen Anforderungen und die Erstellung von Lösungsdesigns für Integrationen, Erweiterungen und Cloud-Workloads.

•
Projektdurchführung: Unterstützung in Migrations- und Innovationsprojekten sowie Durchführung von Workshops, Schulungen und technischen Reviews.

•
Dokumentation & Transfer: Dokumentation, Übergabe und Wissenstransfer an Kunden & interne Teams zur Sicherstellung der Projektergebnisse.

•
Security & Identity: Beratung zu Security & Identity Management sowie Unterstützung bei Betriebskonzepten, z. B. Multi-Tenant, Mandantenfähigkeit und Governance.

•
Betrieb & Optimierung: Unterstützung im Monitoring, Troubleshooting und der Performance-Optimierung zur Sicherstellung eines stabilen Systembetriebs.

•
System-Integration: Integration von SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemen über die SAP Integration Suite.

das bringst du mit

• Berufserfahrung im SAP-Umfeld mit Fokus auf SAP Business Technology Platform.

• Praktische Erfahrung in einem der folgenden Bereiche: SAP Integration Suite, CAP-Entwicklung, SAPUI5/Fiori-Entwicklung oder SAP Build.

• Erfahrung mit Cloud-Architekturen sowie Kenntnisse in SAP Cloud Identity Services.

• Lust darauf, Themen eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

• Spaß an ständiger Weiterentwicklung und Interesse an neuen technologischen Trends.

• Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie am gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch.

• Sicheres Auftreten und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke auf Deutsch und Englisch.

das hast du davon

•
Flexibilität pur : Arbeite so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt - remote im Bundesgebiet, hybrid, oder in einem unserer Offices in Deutschland (Magstadt, Darmstadt, Berlin, München, Hamburg, Köln, Ulm, Heidelberg, Frankfurt).

•
Workation : Arbeiten & neue Orte entdecken? Nutze bis zu 30 Tage Workation im Jahr und verbinde Job & Abenteuer.

•
Auszeiten : Mit 30 Tagen Urlaub tankst du Energie, wann immer du sie brauchst.

•
Deine Hardware, deine Wahl : Mac, Windows oder Linux - du entscheidest, womit du am liebsten arbeitest.

•
Weiterkommen : Schulungen, Labs und Zertifizierungen bei AWS, Azure, Google & SAP - wir pushen dein Cloud-Know-how.

•
Feedback, das zählt : Regelmäßige Entwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche, damit du genau weißt, wo du stehst.

•
Mehr als Basics : wähle zwischen Spendit Card, oder Wellpass oder Deutschlandticket. On top Kita-Zuschuss und Bikeleasing als weitere Extras für dein Leben abseits des Laptops.

•
Teamspirit : Ob Teamevents, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier - wir feiern Erfolge zusammen.
